articles.summary: Code reviews require engineers to assess implementations alongside specifications, tickets and test results to identify gaps that could affect release readiness. This article explores how multiple AI agents can bring that evidence together, flag potential issues and organize follow-up actions — while leaving engineers responsible for validating findings and deciding how to address them.
articles.title: How to Use AI Agents to Streamline Code Reviews
